crossRefs.note: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.

translations.web: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.
translations.bsb: Their young ones thrive and grow up in the open field; they leave and do not return.
translations.kjv: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return
translations.asv: Their young ones become strong, they grow up in the open field; They go forth, and return not again.
